before.frontier: Add optimistic concurrency and commit-aware finalization to proof renewal: refuse renewal when origin/main or the bound recovery tuple moves during the transaction, serialize concurrent renewals, and bind the resulting renewal receipt to the committed Git object identities so a filesystem-valid but uncommitted renewal cannot be mistaken for durable provider state.
